launchSteps.label: Launch temporary player at 1080p Low profile.
launchSteps.notes: Use the P10-C-Pre build only; do not treat it as the final P10-C release package.

launchSteps.label: Record startup and first playable time.
launchSteps.notes: Long load is acceptable only if it does not lead to memory exhaustion or unresponsive player behavior.

observations.label: Record FPS, 1 percent low proxy, and visible stutter.
observations.notes: Low should be near or above 30 FPS and avoid fatal freezes during tsunami start.

observations.label: Trigger green frames and light curtain separately.
observations.notes: Activation may cost frames, but it must not freeze the player.

observations.label: Observe working set, private memory, disk activity, and hard-fault symptoms.
observations.notes: Continuously rising memory or paging-heavy stalls block P10-C until fixed or scoped down.

observations.label: Check Player.log for error spam.
observations.notes: Repeated errors or exception spam block release packaging.

blockingIssues.label: Persistent freeze or unresponsive player during hazard start.
blockingIssues.notes: Classify as needs_major_optimization_before_release unless a small quick fix is obvious.

blockingIssues.label: Memory grows continuously during short run.
blockingIssues.notes: Do not proceed to P10-C release packaging without diagnosis.

quickFixReportTemplate: Quality profile / scenario / timestamp / FPS or stutter symptom / memory working set / private memory / Player.log error count / exact action that triggered the issue.
